prompts.prompt: Review the React components in src/components/ (Cloudscape, react-hook-form, zod) before I open a PR. Write review.md with severity, file:line, why it matters and a fix, most severe first. Do not change any code. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, state it, and finish the work.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill treats native HTML, inline styles, useState form state and any as blocking, and dynamic ColumnLayout columns, untyped useForm and unmemoized handlers as should-fix.
